I understand that Stitch may still be experimental, but the current editing experience makes it very difficult to trust for a real project. The tool needs more precise control, better prompt execution, and safer editing behavior before it can be used seriously in production-level design work.

same a experience and very frustrating

### Related topics [...] Another serious issue is that sometimes Stitch simply stops responding to edits. I can send prompt after prompt, each one more specific than the previous one, but nothing meaningful changes. It feels like I am not doing anything at all. This is extremely frustrating when I am trying to refine one specific section and the tool keeps ignoring the request.

Stitch also frequently creates new pages even when I explicitly tell it not to. I repeatedly write instructions like “do not create a new page” and “modify only the existing page,” yet it still generates new versions or separate pages. This makes the project messy and difficult to manage.
